journey.name: USDT Opt In
journey.description: Use a fresh onboarded wallet with USDT services configured. The wallet has no USDT balance or pending transfers. Use owned payment links and existing requests; no payment is submitted. The explicit-link enable prompt is a swipe-dismissable sheet on iOS; Android uses an alert with Cancel and Enable actions and blocks outside/Back dismissal.

actions.action: On Home, verify the New: USDT sheet (id "UsdtIntro") shows the Tether coin, DOLLARS? YOUR CALL heading, No Thanks and Enable USDT.

With large system text enabled, verify No Thanks and Enable USDT remain fully readable and tappable, stacking vertically when needed. Scroll the introduction to read the complete description, then restore the normal text size before continuing.
Swipe the intro sheet down. Verify Home shows Savings and Spending without a USDT tile. Open Receive and verify there is no USDT tab, then close it.
Terminate and relaunch the app. Verify the USDT intro does not return after it was seen, even when dismissed without selecting Enable or No Thanks.

While USDT remains off on this fresh wallet, use the local gateway request log to verify Home and wallet backups do not request the wallet's USDT balance or history. Bitcoin and Lightning continue normally.
Open Settings, General, Payments. Verify USDT (Tether) (id "UsdtSettingsToggle") is off. Enable it, return Home, and verify the USDT tile appears. Open Receive and verify the USDT tab appears.

Open USDT Send and its network pill. Verify the USDT Network picker (id "UsdtNetworkPicker") uses rounded rows with Tether icons, a teal selection check, the recipient-network explanation and Tether coin illustration. Choose another supported network and verify the pill updates while retaining its network icon.

Return to Settings and turn USDT off while the wallet is empty and all transfers are complete. Verify the USDT tile, receive tab and new Paykit receiving option disappear. Existing payment history remains stored.

With completed USDT history and a zero balance, disable USDT and relaunch. While the balance loads or its refresh fails, history may keep the USDT tile visible, but the Settings switch stays off and can be enabled. Verify Receive and optional address sharing still omit USDT. Enable it and verify the switch stays on and cannot be disabled until the zero balance is confirmed.

Open an owned USDT payment link while USDT is off. Verify the Enable USDT prompt (id "UsdtEnablePrompt"). Decline and verify USDT stays off, the flow returns to the previous screen, and no payment spinner or failure screen remains. Where interactive dismissal is available, open the link again and dismiss the prompt without tapping Cancel; verify the same quiet return with no USDT wallet or Send/Receive controls left open. Open the link again, enable USDT (id "UsdtEnablePromptContinue"), and verify the recipient and exact amount continue into the payment flow. Cancel without paying.
With a funded wallet or an unresolved transfer, open Settings. Verify USDT is visibly on, greyed out and cannot be toggled. Verify the wallet, history and pending payment remain accessible.

Restore an owned funded wallet whose USDT preference is absent or off. Verify USDT is enabled and its Settings switch is on and greyed out. Open Receive from Home and verify it keeps the normal default tab (Auto when available, otherwise Savings). Select the available USDT tab and verify its receiving address appears without an enable prompt. No payment is submitted.
